name: homePos
meaning: Init pos (when in the world) or pos at msg 9 arg 1; restored by msg 0x55.

name: treePosReply
meaning: Scratch: the msg 0x3280 reply pointer (Tree.seedPos), filled with the tree position.

name: arrivalQuery
meaning: Scratch: the msg 0x3281 argument (sphere's wolf/gossamer arrival query); .pos is written with a box corner.

name: sphere
meaning: the TimeMachineSphere: FindByClass(0x56) in Init, or NULL; no reader in the Seed code.

name: tree
meaning: TREE property (Scn_GetPropObject offset 4); receives msg 0x3300 (visible = state 4) on every msg 0x3c. Not NULL-checked.

name: sheepScratch
meaning: Scratch copy of g_pSheepOutOfZone (0x6cf264) during msg 0x3c; the sheep that gets moved out of a tree spot.

name: gossamer
meaning: Gossamer_Lev08 (class 0x57) from FindByClass, or NULL. Moved to a box corner by msg 0x3c.

name: zones
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: BOXES id list (past-era planting boxes, 16-byte Box). Used for the plant test (msg 0x17), the tree position (0x3280) and the arrival corner (0x3281). | count (+4): Entry count of boxes (5 in Lvl-09, 7 in Lvl-10).

name: presentBoxes
meaning: Copies of boxes[i] with min and max shifted by g_timeMachineOffsetToPresent; used only by msg 0x3c (sheep/Gossamer relocation). The array has 10 slots up to the object end 0x12c, and Init has no bound check.
